Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: Rebuilt scanning and comparison engine for major speed improvements, added 4-tier speed badge, Light/Dark themes, live EN/JA switching, Error Log view, Tree View diff filters/navigation, and updated .json.gz snapshot format.

English.Char_Desc_80: High-speed ACL verification tool for file server migrations.
English.Char_Desc_250: ACL Migration Checker is a high-speed, portable tool to verify access control list (ACL) differences between source and destination during file server migrations, supporting Active Directory and Workgroup environments.
English.Char_Desc_450: ACL Migration Checker verifies access control list (ACL) differences between source and destination during file or storage server migrations. It rapidly scans ACLs into compact .json.gz snapshots, compares structures across differing hostnames or top folders (including Workgroup accounts and Deny rules), offers Tree View, Diff List, and Error Log views, switches Light/Dark themes and EN/JA live, and exports Excel-ready CSVs.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
ACL Migration Checker: High-speed access rights verification for reliable data migration.
ACL Migration Checker is a dedicated verification tool designed to detect access control list (ACL) discrepancies between source and destination during file server and storage server migrations. It is highly effective in Active Directory environments as well as Workgroup environments where SID migration is difficult.
Key Features: - High-Speed Scanning & Snapshots: Rapidly scans local drives and network shares into compact .json.gz files for offline comparison. Automatically selects the optimal scan mode with a 4-tier speed indicator badge in the header (ultra-fast mode on local NTFS as Admin). - Flexible Migration Comparison: Accurately compares folder structures and permissions (including Deny rules) even when hostnames, IP addresses, or top-level folder names change, including Workgroup local account matching, deep paths (>260 chars), and junctions. - Three Workspace Views & Side-by-Side ACL Details: Inspect differences in synchronized Tree View (Diffs Only, Folders Only, Prev/Next navigation, Open Folder), Diff List (status filters, keyword search, Copy Path), and Error Log, with exact permissions compared side by side below. - Themes, Live Language Switch & CSV Export: Switch Light/Dark themes and English/Japanese live without restarting, and export diff results and error logs as Excel-ready CSV files. - Portable NativeAOT Design: Requires no installation, registry setup, or external .NET runtime. Note: .json.gz files from v26.11.23.0+ are not compatible with v1 (26.7.31.2).
Developed by chilili kobo. Freeware for personal and commercial use.
